sampling: Uniform without replacement over ordered distinct CGD names with identical space-group setting strings; exclude all catalogue dual pairs and both orientations of every old pair. No rank, flatness, rigidity, degree or size filter. Roles are sampled, never swapped.
placement: Original 8^3 clearance maximization in scaffold physical conventional cell, then 1.05 nearest-vertex contact shell.
replacement_method: Retain all originally selected 3D pairs; uniformly supplement from remaining 3D population, without spectra. Conditional subset plus uniform supplementation is a uniform sample of 300 distinct ordered 3D pairs.
cell_protocol: Prospective predictions and all same-group outcomes use the exact common primitive translation cell; retrospective predictions use the conventional cell of the scaffold.
